verdict.rationale: HumanLayer documents a GitHub connection, but it is described as turning issues into tasks and linking artifacts back. Separately, release notes say a session agent can open a draft pull request from the GitHub tab or diff view. Code access comes from workspace config that creates task worktrees on a host that can already reach the code, not from connecting a GitHub repository. Missing for 10: documented repo connection granting the agent code access, non-draft PR creation details, permissions/auth scope docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect a GitHub repository so an agent can access the code and open pull requests against it

citations.quote: Connect GitHub to create HumanLayer tasks from issues and link task artifacts back to the source issue.
Draft PR creation — Ask the session agent to open a draft pull request from the GitHub tab or diff view.
Use workspace config to create task worktrees for one or more repositories.
